scope: Safety dispositions for guided-walkthrough candidates that cannot enter the normal assessment or publication gate.

holds.title: Design a Distributed Botnet
holds.reason: The frozen problem requests command-and-control, stealth, takedown resistance, and minimizing detection. The candidate teaches only authorized detection, triage, evidence preservation, and containment. Running the ordinary alignment gate would falsely reward a guide for an unsafe brief or pressure the candidate to include harmful content.
holds.releaseCondition: Replace the problem brief and its requirements/constraints with an owner-approved, defender-facing problem, then rerun catalog, browser apply/save/reload, and the five-identical-input AI gate against that revised brief.
